sql: with spans as (select s.security_id,s.current_ticker,min(o.pvm) first_date,max(o.pvm) last_date from f.security s join o.osakedata o on o.osake=s.current_ticker and o.market='usa' group by 1,2) select spy.pvm,count(*) missing_routes from o.osakedata spy join spans s on spy.pvm between s.first_date and s.last_date where spy.osake='SPY' and spy.market='usa' and not exists(select 1 from o.osakedata x where x.osake=s.current_ticker and x.market='usa' and x.pvm=spy.pvm) group by spy.pvm order by count(*) desc limit 12
